title: JWT Authentication Success
description: Verify that a user can successfully authenticate using valid JWT tokens and access personal, workspace, and admin resources according to their tier-based permissions.

steps.description: Send authentication request with valid JWT token.
Verify authentication is successful and access is granted according to user tier.

title: JWT Authentication Failure with Invalid Token
description: Verify that authentication fails when an invalid or expired JWT token is provided and the system denies access.

steps.description: Send authentication request with invalid/expired JWT token.
Verify authentication is denied and appropriate error is returned.

title: Tiered Access Control Enforcement
description: Verify that users only have access to personal, workspace, and administrative resources according to their assigned tier permissions.

steps.description: Authenticate as different tier users (personal, workspace member, admin).
Attempt to access resources restricted to higher tiers.
Verify access is restricted appropriately based on tier.

title: Dataset Upload and Automatic Cleaning
description: Verify that users can upload or connect datasets which trigger automatic data forensics and cleaning engines detecting anomalies, null values, and validating integrity.

steps.description: Upload or connect a dataset containing valid and invalid data including nulls and anomalies.
Verify automatic cleaning engine detects anomalies and null values and performs first-principles validation.
Verify cleaning changes are irreversible and audit trails are created.

title: Data Cleaning Audit Trail Integrity
description: Verify that all data cleaning operations generate irreversible backups and full audit trails are maintained for traceability.

steps.description: Perform dataset cleaning operation.
Verify that irreversible backup is created before cleaning.
Verify audit trail records all cleaning actions with timestamps and user details.

title: AI-Generated Strategic Report Accuracy
description: Verify that AI-generated strategic reports accurately synthesize real enterprise data, highlight key metrics, identify anomalies, and provide actionable insights without restating trivial information.

steps.description: Request AI to generate a strategic report from a given dataset.
Verify report contains synthesized narrative with key metrics.
Verify anomalies and root causes are highlighted.
Verify report does not restate obvious or trivial metrics.

title: Dynamic AI-Suggested Dashboard Generation
description: Verify that AI-suggested dashboards dynamically generate appropriate visualizations based on dataset semantics and business goals, strictly avoiding placeholder data.

steps.description: Provide datasets with different semantics: temporal, correlation, compositional.
Verify temporal data is shown as line charts.
Verify correlation data is shown as scatter plots.
Verify compositional data uses appropriate charts like pie or stacked bar.
Verify no placeholder or dummy data appears in any visualization.

title: Conversational Analyst NL-to-Insight Query Handling
description: Verify that the Conversational Analyst copilot correctly interprets natural language queries to explore datasets and modify reports, backed by real data and semantic validation.

steps.description: Submit a natural language query to explore dataset insights or request report modifications.
Verify the copilot returns relevant, semantically valid insights or report changes based on underlying data.

title: Synthetic Data Generation Realism and Security
description: Verify that AI-powered synthetic data generation produces realistic mock datasets for testing and simulation without compromising the integrity or security of real source data.

steps.description: Request synthetic dataset generation based on real enterprise data schema.
Verify generated synthetic data mimics real data distribution and characteristics.
Verify no real or sensitive user data is leaked or present in synthetic data.

title: Fraud-Proof Data and Dashboard Modification Audit Trails
description: Verify that all modifications to datasets and dashboards are version controlled, auditable, and maintain fraud-proof connection layers with secure credential handling.

steps.description: Modify datasets and dashboards with various user accounts.
Verify all changes are versioned with detailed audit trails.
Verify audit trails record user identity, timestamp, and change details.
Verify that unauthorized changes are rejected based on security rules.

title: Predictive Scheduling Reduces Unnecessary Meetings
description: Verify that AI-driven predictive scheduling and automated report generation minimize unnecessary meetings and interruptions while allowing meetings for necessary human ethical decision-making.

steps.description: Simulate task assignments and reporting scenarios requiring coordination.
Verify meetings are only automatically scheduled when human intervention or ethical judgment is required.
Verify proactive notifications and voice-narrated reports reduce scheduling load.

title: System Response Stability Under High Concurrency
description: Verify system maintains low-latency, stable, and resilient responses under high load and concurrent usage of AI coordination engine without race conditions or errors.

steps.description: Simulate multiple concurrent users interacting with AI coordination engine and generating reports/dashboards.
Verify system maintains low response latency below SLA thresholds.
Verify no race conditions, data corruption, or errors occur.

title: Graceful Failure Handling of External Services
description: Verify that the system tolerates failures or unavailability of external services gracefully without disrupting core user workflows or data integrity.

steps.description: Simulate failure or timeout in external AI service or data source.
Verify user workflows continue to operate with fallback behavior or informative error messages.
Verify no data corruption or loss occurs.
